subject: Choosing bedroom colours and finishes
hook: Will a dark wardrobe make my bedroom feel smaller?
fb:
"I love the darker finishes, but won't they make my bedroom feel tiny?"

Not necessarily. When fitted wardrobes run floor to ceiling in one colour, they start to read as a wall rather than a big piece of furniture, and that can actually make a room feel calmer and more finished than a freestanding wardrobe in a light colour.

Dark finishes do need light, though. With reasonable daylight or good bedside lamps, they look rich. In a small, north-facing room, an oak-effect or mid-tone can give you warmth without the risk.

We'll bring samples so you can see for yourself. Ask your question below or book a consultation.

Will dark fitted wardrobes make my bedroom feel smaller?

Not necessarily. Floor-to-ceiling fitted wardrobes in a single colour read as a wall rather than a bulky piece of furniture, which can make a bedroom feel calmer and more finished.

Darker finishes such as charcoal or black woodgrain look best with reasonable daylight or good bedside lighting. In a small, north-facing room, an oak-effect or lighter finish can be a safer choice that still feels warm.
